title: market.tick.v1
description: Real transport contract (Kafka transport task; promoted from the architecture-freeze skeleton). Per docs/architecture/analysis-engine.md's tick-data-separation section: consumed for spread/velocity/quote-acceleration/micro-rejection/execution-microstructure quality only, never as the primary source for major swing structure, BOS/CHoCH, order blocks, or dealing ranges. No live tick producer exists yet (this is ctrader-engine's future work, not this task's) — analysis-engine's own decoder/contract is ready ahead of that, and tick consumption stays disabled by default via transport.kafka.tick_consumption_enabled (config/transport.yml) until a real producer exists (source task §3/§28). This is the PAYLOAD only — wrapped inside contracts/common/event-envelope-v1.schema.json's `payload` field.

canonical_symbol.description: Canonical instrument identifier, e.g. "XAU" — matches market.Symbol exactly, same identity discipline as market.bar.closed.v1's canonical_symbol.

broker_symbol.description: The broker/feed's own symbol spelling, if it differs from canonical_symbol. Pure metadata, same as bar-closed-v1's broker_symbol field.

time.description: Unix SECONDS (source task §9's timestamp-unit decision, resolved: seconds uniformly across every contract — see docs/transport/kafka.md's "Timestamp standard" section for why sub-second tick resolution was deliberately NOT adopted despite being the more obviously tick-appropriate choice: no live tick producer exists yet to need it, and introducing a second timestamp unit into this system for a not-yet-produced event class was judged not worth the mixed-unit risk this same section warns against). A future tick-v2 contract may revisit this once a real producer's actual achievable resolution is known.
